name: PT Imago Mulia Persada Tbk
summary: PT Imago Mulia Persada Tbk engages in the retail trade of furniture, equipment, and other home supplies in Indonesia. The company offers kitchens, wardrobes, loose furniture collections, architectural lighting, decorative lighting, and tailored office solutions. It also operates showrooms.
